## Last-checked: 2026-09-22

# MarbleRun / llmauto - LLM Automation Framework

> MarbleRun (package name: llmauto, version 0.1.3) is a chain-execution framework for autonomous LLM agent loops. Multiple agents work in sequence -- workers execute tasks, reviewers check results, controllers coordinate -- passing context from link to link via handoff files. Named after a marble run: the context rolls through the chain, agent by agent.

llmauto is the automation layer of the ellmos family: define multi-agent chains in JSON, run them autonomously with persistent state, stop/resume support, and Telegram status updates. Supports mixing Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku in a single chain with role-based skip logic. Zero external runtime dependencies (pure Python standard library + Claude Code CLI, with optional COMA provider adapter for Codex and Agy). Python 3.10+, MIT, Level 1 SBOM audited.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/MarbleRun
Canonical package / CLI name: llmauto
Canonical search phrases: ellmos MarbleRun; llmauto Claude Code automation; MarbleRun LLM agent chains; local-first multi-agent orchestration Python.

Disambiguation: this repo is not edgelesssys/marblerun, not a confidential-computing control plane, and not a game or Blender marble-run toolkit. It is the ellmos-ai Python automation framework for Claude Code and autonomous LLM agent chains.

Core concepts: Chain (JSON definition with ordered links), Link (one agent with role, model, prompt), Role (worker / reviewer / controller with skip-if-not-assigned), Handoff (context-passing file between links), Marble Run Pattern (sequential loops with max_rounds / runtime limits), Pipe Mode (one-shot CLI calls), Background Execution (chains run in separate terminal windows).

Governance & Runtime Invariants: 10 formal invariants INV-LOCAL-01 (Zero-Egress), INV-SEC-02 (User-Mode RunAsInvoker), INV-GATE-03 (Multi-Provider Fail-Closed), INV-SYNC-04 (Race-Free Parallel Workspaces), INV-CONT-05 (Anti-Starvation Skip Guard), INV-STATE-06 (Persistent Transparent State Machine), INV-PROC-07 (Shell-Free Execution), INV-CI-08 (Multi-OS CI Matrix), INV-CONC-09 (Strict Concurrency Gate), and INV-SLA-10 (Cryptographic Auditability & Dual SLAs).

## Target Personas

- `[PERSONA-01]`: Autonomous AI Agent Engineers & Chain Builders (unattended multi-agent execution loops)
- `[PERSONA-02]`: Multi-Agent Swarm & Handoff Architects (deterministic context handoffs & anti-starvation skip protection)
- `[PERSONA-03]`: Enterprise Tooling, Safety & Governance Compliance Officers (zero-egress, RunAsInvoker, Level 1 SBOM, dual SLAs)
- `[PERSONA-04]`: Open-Source AI Tool Builders & Local-First Developers (zero-dependency Python stdlib tooling)
